x: New faces are always welcome and this season the road running ranks have been swelled by Gerry North, Bill Kerr, Charlie Walker, George Williams John Moore and Peter Wrench; and with Jack Brown showing a return to form, things look good for next season.
Pete Wrench and George Piddington finished 54th (83:07) and 71st(89:36) Pete's time qualifies towards 2nd class standard. 89 ran.

Charlie Manning later boasted that he and Peter Wrench accounted for most of it in an effort to drink one another under the table. After the interval the pace hotted up even more, the band breaking into a few Charleston numbers.

Don Maclean started about 12 minutes behind the feild but was unable to catch any tail-enders in the next 42 minutes. At least he must have enjoyed it more than Bob Glover and Peter Wrench who went off course and were not recorded in!
A little further back Brian Gorman looked a good bet for the handicap when he came home 13th in 30m. 04s., but further back still Peter Wrench was skating it.

Let us hope that being married to a Belgravian, and a real 'case'at that, will not affect Barbara's international career as a high jumper. More congratulations are due, this time to PETER WRENCH and his wife ANN. Ann has recently given birth to a daughter, their second child.
